findings.explanation: Distinct destination ports reached from one source to one destination, within one transport protocol. TCP counts SYN without ACK; UDP counts valid headers.
findings.limitation: Legitimate discovery can trigger this rule. Distributed or slow sweeps may be missed. Contact does not establish compromise.
findings.recommendation: Check authorized scanning, service discovery, host role, and responses in the supporting frames.
findings.title: Potential port sweep (TCP)

findings.explanation: SYN packets without ACK on the same directed address/port tuple reached the threshold. Retransmissions are included.
findings.limitation: Repeated packets are not necessarily separate connection attempts. Missing replies do not prove failure or malicious intent.
findings.recommendation: Inspect SYN sequence numbers and reverse traffic; check loss, service availability, and capture placement.
findings.title: Repeated TCP SYN activity

findings.explanation: Packets OR captured bytes sent by one decoded IP source reached a fixed threshold in a sliding window.
findings.limitation: This is a fixed volume rule, not a learned baseline. Captured bytes include link headers and may omit truncated data. Benign bursts are expected.
findings.recommendation: Compare with the host's normal workload, backups, transfers, and capture duplication; inspect destinations and timing.
findings.title: Concentrated traffic burst

findings.explanation: UDP port-53 packets with a decoded DNS header, QR=0 and at least one valid question reached the per-source threshold.
findings.limitation: Counts query packets, including duplicates, not unique names. DNS over TCP, encrypted DNS and other ports are not analyzed. High rate is not proof of tunneling.
findings.recommendation: Review queried names, retransmissions, resolver behavior, and the expected workload of the source host.
findings.title: High DNS query activity

limitations: Educational triage tool, not a certified forensic procedure or legal chain of custody.
Timestamps are capture-clock observations interpreted as UTC; clock accuracy is unknown.
No IP reassembly, TCP stream reassembly, checksum validation, decryption, or application transfer-size inference.
Heuristic findings require context; priorities are triage policy, not calibrated probabilities.
Hash covers the complete acquired file; a limited or damaged record stream may yield only a prefix analysis.
Report contains addresses, ports and DNS questions; review before sharing.
